# chopin.data

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/FlorenceMounier/chopin.data/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/FlorenceMounier/chopin.data/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of chopin.data is to provide well-documented, ready-to-use R data objects.

## Installation

You can install the development version of chopin.data from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("FlorenceMounier/chopin.data")
```
